name: a2bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean shapes, lots of calm white space. Unbranded, no text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of an airport, like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO planes, NO vehicles and NO people: a pale light blue sky with a few big soft white fluffy clouds fills the top three quarters of the picture, low rolling green hills along the horizon, and across the whole bottom of the picture a straight horizontal band of dark grey runway tarmac with a thin white dashed line along it, lying on a strip of green grass. The runway runs from the left edge to the right edge, it does not go into the distance.
